name: Mehmed II
contribution: The sultan of the Ottoman Empire twice, from August 1444 to September 1446 and again from February 1451 to May 1481.
legacy: In 1453, at the age of 21, he this person Constantinople and effectively brought an end to the Byzantine Empire

checks.lead: Mehmed II  (Ottoman Turkish: محمد ثانى, romanized: Meḥemmed-i s̱ānī; Turkish: II. Mehmed, pronounced [icinˈdʒi ˈmehmet]; 30 March 1432 – 3 May 1481), commonly known as Mehmed the Conqueror (Ottoman Turkish: ابو الفتح, romanized: Ebū'l-fetḥ, lit. 'the Father of Conquest'; Turkish: Fâtih Sultan Mehmed), was the sultan of the Ottoman Empire twice, from August 1444 to September 1446 and again from February 1451 to May 1481.
